email.subject: Forge Works Fitness: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I took a look at Forge Works Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: it's not mobile-friendly, and there's no click-to-call button. Most people searching for a gym do it on their phone, often while deciding right then whether to call. If they have to pinch-zoom and then hunt for your number, a lot of them just call the next gym instead.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's broken and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
